senses.sense_definition: An explanation or description that leaves out so many important details that it distorts the truth or makes something appear simpler than it really is.

examples.text: Calling the economic crisis a mere lack of confidence is a gross <w>oversimplification</w>.
His summary contained several <w>oversimplifications</w> that annoyed the researchers.

senses.sense_definition: The act or process of describing or explaining something in a way that ignores its real complexity.

examples.text: The dangerous tendency toward <w>oversimplification</w> in public debates undermines productive solutions.
By avoiding <w>oversimplification</w>, the author gives a balanced and thorough account of the conflict.
